title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-q4fj: DaoProcessError::NotAdmitted is dead code — never produced
description:
## Location
`rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:822`, `rust/lichen-node/src/node.rs:86,378`

## Problem
The commit adds `NotAdmitted` to both `DaoProcessError` and `DaoHandlingOutcome`, plus a match arm in `handle_verified_dao()`. However:

1. **`DaoProcessError::NotAdmitted` is never returned from any code path in `lichen-rpl`.** `process_signature_verified_inner` (routing.rs:1471) returns only `RouteRejected`, `Replay`, `Stale`, `Exhausted`, `Corrupt`, `Persistence`. The `CheckRedundantSink` result can only yield `RouteRejected` or `Stale` (routing.rs:1539,5043). No path produces `NotAdmitted`.

2. **The actual admission check is in `rpl_stack.rs:1324-1333`** using `RplReceiveOutcome::DaoOriginNotAdmitted` (a completely different enum), performed BEFORE `handle_dao()` is called at line 1335. This means an unadmitted origin is rejected by `rpl_stack.rs` before DAO processing even begins, so `DaoProcessError::NotAdmitted` is unreachable.

3. **The original bead issue (project-LICHEN-worker6-q4fj) was incorrect:** `DaoProcessError` never gained `NotAdmitted` in a prior commit — the variant didn't exist in HEAD~1 in either file. This commit adds it to both files simultaneously, creating dead code under the mistaken belief it was fixing a compilation error.

## Fix
Either:
- Move the admission check from `rpl_stack.rs` into `process_signature_verified_inner` so it produces `DaoProcessError::NotAdmitted`, OR
- Remove the `NotAdmitted` variant from both enums as dead code.
